info.title: BrightPath API
info.description:
Backend API for BrightPath: NEET rank predictor, college finder and student enquiries.

This spec is the contract for the frontend. Every route documents its summary, parameters, request body and responses. Exported to `docs/openapi.json` via `bun run openapi:export`.

**Errors.** Every non-2xx response uses one body shape, `{ error: { code, message, fields?, requestId } }`. `fields` lists per-field problems for form validation (HTTP 422). `requestId` matches the `X-Request-Id` header.

**Empty query values.** A query parameter sent with an empty value (`?limit=`) is treated as not provided.

**Rate limits.** Public routes are limited per IP. When exceeded the API answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header.

**Staff auth.** `/admin/*` routes need a staff session: `POST /admin/auth/login` sets an httpOnly `bp_session` cookie; send requests with credentials. Writes must also send `X-BP-Admin: 1`. Roles: ADMIN (everything), EDITOR (content and data), COUNSELLOR (enquiries). 401 = not logged in, 403 = not allowed.

**Changelog.** 0.5.1: a locked staff account now answers 429 with error code `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` (was `RATE_LIMITED`); a refused setting value now explains what is allowed. 0.5.0: NEET rank predictor (`GET /neet/rank`, `GET /neet/data-sources`) and NEET data admin (years, cut-offs, score-count upload, preview, publish). 0.4.0: reference data admin (states, countries, sources, NMC notices). 0.3.1: blank query parameters are treated as not provided. 0.3.0: staff login/roles, staff management, site settings, versioned disclaimers, audit log, `GET /site/config`. 0.2.0: foundation (error envelope, request ids, rate limiting, security headers).

get.summary: Predict NEET (UG) rank from a score
get.description:
Turns a NEET (UG) score into an All-India rank **range** using the official NTA result data. The same score always gives the same answer (`tableVersion` identifies the exact table used). Ranks are ranges because tied students share a band of ranks.

- `result.outcome` is `BELOW_CUTOFF` when the score is under the qualifying cut-off; rank fields are then null.
- `result.outcome` is `NOT_PUBLISHED_BY_NTA` when NTA published no score counts for that year (only totals and cut-offs); rank fields are null, `qualification` is still given, and the explanation says why. Show that message instead of a rank.
- `result.approximate` is true when the year's data only has counts per mark range; show the estimate as approximate and mention `possibleRankSpan`.
- `categoryRank` / `pwdRank` are null when the year's data does not support them (never guessed).
- `otherYears` gives the same score in every other published year (for "same score in the other year").
- `meta.disclaimer` must be shown with the answer.

Supports `ETag` / `If-None-Match`. 404 until a year is published; 422 for an unavailable `year` or a score outside -180..720.

post.description: Starts a staff session and sets the `bp_session` cookie (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production). Wrong email and wrong password give the same 401 message. After 5 wrong passwords the account is locked for 15 minutes: further attempts, even with the right password, answer 429 with error code `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` and a `Retry-After` header. Separately, more than 10 attempts per minute from one IP answer 429 with code `RATE_LIMITED`. Cookie-authenticated writes must send the header `X-BP-Admin: 1` (CSRF protection); the browser also sends an `Origin` that must be on the allow-list.
